ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels (ventral surface) to 15% low-intensity black pixels (borders and focal spots).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized contiguous high-intensity white region spanning both lobes. Low-intensity black banding localized on the inferior margin (peduncle attachment) and trailing edges. High-density distribution of discrete low-intensity circular rings (5-15 pixel diameter) across the mid-to-lateral white fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation; approximately 52-degree internal angle with a vertical depth of ~120 pixels relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile. Pixel-amplitude of peaks varies between 3-12 pixels. Pronounced jagged morphology on the distal lateral tips compared to the medial trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lobate sigmoid curve; concave transition from median notch to mid-lobe, transitioning to convex towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive detection of annular/circular high-contrast dark pixel clusters. Highest spatial density observed on the right lobe distal region and along the interior of both lateral tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, vertical low-intensity striations visible on the lower-left quadrant, extending from the inferior black margin into the white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized clusters of high-intensity calcified structures (barnacles) on the extreme lateral tips. Irregular traumatic notching and loss of edge integrity on the far right trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple 3-8 pixel diameter yellowish-tan focal points scattered across the medial-white region of both lobes, distinct from the black circular scarring.
